sentiment.rationale: Management raised the quarterly dividend by 50% and introduced a new higher pretax margin target of 30% for Asset & Wealth Management, signaling confidence in forward earnings growth. The firm also reported a record backlog and expressed optimism for 2026 M&A and capital markets activity, though no formal EPS or revenue guidance was raised. The score reflects genuine operational momentum and confident forward language, but stops short of a full guidance raise.

summary.revenue: Full year 2025 net revenues of $58.28 billion, 9% higher than 2024. Fourth quarter 2025 net revenues of $13.45 billion, 3% lower than Q4 2024.
summary.eps: Full year 2025 diluted EPS of $51.32, a 27% increase versus $40.54 in 2024. Fourth quarter 2025 EPS of $14.01, up from $11.95 in Q4 2024.
summary.guidance: Management reaffirmed mid-teens firm-wide return targets and introduced a new 30% pretax margin target for Asset & Wealth Management. A new target of 5% long-term fee-based net inflows annually from the wealth platform was also introduced. Management expressed optimism for 2026 M&A and capital markets activity, stating 'we are optimistic about the forward outlook for Goldman Sachs.'
summary.margin: Asset & Wealth Management pretax margin was 25% for 2025. A new medium-term target of 30% was introduced.
key_risks: Economic growth, policy uncertainty, geopolitical developments, and market volatility are factors management continues to monitor closely.
Potential for an exogenous event or macro event to change sentiment and slow M&A activity.
NIM compression expected in private banking and lending due to rate cycle expectations.
Platform Solutions (Apple Card) expected to have a small pretax loss for the year, though not material.
key_opportunities: Highest investment banking backlog in four years, with seventh consecutive quarterly increase, primarily driven by advisory.
Expectation of accelerating M&A and capital markets activity in 2026, supported by corporate focus on scale, AI investment, and sponsor activity.
New 30% pretax margin target for Asset & Wealth Management, with growth in wealth management, alternatives, and solutions.
Expansion of durable financing revenues, which comprised 37% of total FICC and equity revenues in 2025.
Regulatory tailwinds from a more balanced regulatory regime, including potential capital flexibility and reduced compliance costs.
Opportunities in tokenization and prediction markets.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management used language such as 'I am very pleased with our strong performance,' 'we are optimistic about the forward outlook,' and 'we are confident that we will continue to deliver on these [targets].'
